name: @loomwork/reasoning-audit
description: Model reasoning as audit evidence (ADR 0133): an expense-approval agent on agentLoop$ whose reasoning model's thinking is captured at the provider seam into a sidecar content store, kept OUT of the log (the step value holds signatures, refs and digests, never readable text), sent back unchanged on the next turn, read back tainted by an auditor with readReasoning, erasable without breaking replay, sealed to its execution (a forged ref is dropped), streamed live on its own channel through a conversation hub, and discarded-with-a-warning (or refused) on the direct routed path. Offline, scripted Anthropic-shaped model.
